main.description: Implemented by feed generators, not the AppView. Returns references only: which posts or job postings, in which order. The AppView hydrates them and applies its own policy, so anything a skeleton names may still be left out. Personalised feeds take service auth: a token the viewer's PDS signed, with aud = the generator's DID and lxm = this NSID, which the AppView forwards.

cursor.description: Opaque to everyone but the generator.
